To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

social media is a complex and multi-faceted phenomenon, which can be unpacked by a honeycomb of functional building blocks; each functional building block has its own set of theoretical lenses that can be used to explore social media dynamics in public affairs; and the combination of all theoretical lenses can provide a powerful macro lens for research on social-media dynamics in public affairs.
the use of social media by public affairs practitioners is a social phenomenon and that social media can be understood as a socio-technical phenomenon.
social media is a complex phenomenon and that it is necessary to use a multi-theoretical approach when researching social media.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of social media in shaping the dynamics of public affairs.
understanding how social media is changing the way public affairs practitioners communicate and interact with the public and other stakeholders.
understanding social media as an emergent phenomenon.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
social media is a complex phenomenon that is not easily defined.
social media are a phenomenon that has been around for a long time, but has only recently become more prominent and more widely used.
social media has become the new normal in public affairs, and the new normal is not just a passing fad.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the paper provides an initial conceptualization of social and socio-technological dynamics that can be used as a starting point for research on social and socio-technology dynamics in the context of social media.
the social media phenomenon is not just a new form of communication, but also a new form of public participation.
the honeycomb model is a useful tool for conceptualizing and studying the dynamics of social media.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need for a more nuanced and multi-disciplinary approach to studying the social media phenomenon.
social media are not simply a new communication channel.
social media is a phenomenon that is more than a technology or a platform, and it is important for public administration and public affairs scholars to understand the phenomenon as a whole.
